And the frustrating thing is, most of those stockouts and overstock situations aren't because business owners aren't paying attention. It's because manually tracking inventory is genuinely hard to keep up with when you're also running everything else.

Inventory alerts change the game quietly. Instead of you checking spreadsheets or counting shelves at the end of a long day, you get a simple notification when something is running low — so you can reorder before you're caught short, not after.

No more apologizing to a customer because that thing they drove across town for is out of stock. No more tying up cash in products that are just sitting there collecting dust.
